LLLiquor licence search research /San Francisco, in pictures

The worked example, drawn

Thirteen pages, one city

San Francisco is a consolidated city and county, and the site built a /cities/ set and a /counties/ set for it. Thirteen live addresses now answer the same question for the same searchers. Five should. This page shows the change instead of describing it.

Word counts from the 12 September 2026 census. All thirteen pages re-fetched and screenshotted live on 13 September 2026 — every one returned HTTP 200 with no redirect. Modelled visits are DataForSEO estimates calculated from ranking position and search volume, not measured sessions.

01 — The architecture

Thirteen addresses collapse to five

Every current page is joined to the page that replaces it. Colour is fate: blue folds in, green supplies the new page’s base text, orange is the one filed in the wrong county folder.

  • Consolidate — 8 pages. Address retired, a single 301 to the destination, own words merged in.
  • Keep and rebuild — 4 pages. The body becomes the base text of the new page; the old address still redirects.
  • Wrong folder — 1 page. San Francisco County Type 47 is filed inside /counties/los-angeles-county/. One of only two genuine cross-jurisdiction misfiles on the whole site.
  • Hold list — 2 pages, drawn dashed. Their canonical target 301s straight back at them, so they cannot be repointed until that loop is cleared. Take them out of the bulk batch.

The thirteen carry 16,727 words between them, 10,495 of which are their own, and draw 4.2 modelled visits a month at a best position of 10th. The rival’s single San Francisco page draws 22.2 at positions 3rd, 3rd, 4th and 10th — that is its measured model today, not a forecast for the five. Type 41 gets no page of its own: there is no San Francisco Type 41 stock and neither existing Type 41 page ranks for anything, so both fold into the hub as a section.

03 — Three numbers

Why thirteen lose to one

  • 2.6×

    The client’s city-type pages write 2.6 times more of their own words than the rival page that outranks them, and lose anyway. This is not a content-quality problem. It is an architecture problem.

    • Client city-type template895.5
    • Rival county template339

    Median own words per template, both domains, same instrument, same run. Sample of 12–16 pages per template.

  • 13th

    The generic query “liquor license san francisco” is answered by the Type 48 bars and nightclubs page. The narrowest page in the set fields the broadest question, while the 1,332-word overview page written for exactly that query ranks for nothing.

    • liquor license san francisco13th · rival 3rd
    • san francisco liquor license18th · rival 4th
    • sf liquor license21st · rival 10th

    Each row is a 1-to-25 position scale, left is better: the client, the rival. Six of the nine ranked San Francisco terms sit on that one Type 48 page. Census of the supplier’s index, 12 September 2026.

  • 5.3×

    Thirteen pages draw 4.2 modelled visits a month between them. The rival’s one page draws 22.2. Per page, the gap is 69-fold.

    • 13 client pages4.2
    • 1 rival page22.2

    Modelled monthly visits: a calculation from ranking position and search volume. An estimate, not measured sessions.

The twelve flat canonical targets these pages declare must be redirected in the same release: every San Francisco ranking sits on one of those, not on the sitemap address. Two of them 301 straight back and are the hold list. The full canonical map, and the written titles, descriptions and page text, are in the worked example.

Where this sits

This page is the picture. The written detail — every canonical, title, description, paragraph and internal link that changes — is in the worked example. The design direction it is drawn against is the approved live build.

The worked example, written out → The approved live build → All the reports →

No licence number, licensee name, trading name or premises address appears on this page or on any of the five proposed pages. A listing shows county, municipality, licence class, price, availability and days on market only; the record detail is released to a qualified buyer under NDA, and the pages state that withholding as a reason to enquire rather than showing a redacted teaser. The five “after” screenshots are of sample data invented for design review.
